title: Nexus FindingsApi
description: Handler-local wire DTOs for the findings family without an existing schema (`findings-api` destination): the retention prune outcome. The PATCH tri-state (`rule_suggestion`) is owned by `schemas/daemon-api/findings/update-finding-request.schema.json` and must never be duplicated here (R-V1190-FINDINGS-TRISTATE-DUP: single wire definition, no parallel handwritten shape).

FindingsPruneResponse.title: FindingsPruneResponse
FindingsPruneResponse.description: Response for `POST /v1/daemon/findings/prune` (V1.49 P3, quality-loop §9.4). `count` is the number of rows deleted, or that would be deleted under `dry_run`.

older_than_days.description: Resolved retention threshold in days (bounded server default when the query omits it).

now_epoch.description: Server-side epoch second used for the cutoff.
